args.query:
CREATE TABLE cleaned_measurements AS
SELECT * 
FROM measurements
WHERE cognitive_score NOT IN (
    SELECT cognitive_score
    FROM measurements
    WHERE cognitive_score < (SELECT AVG(cognitive_score) - 3 * (SELECT (MAX(cognitive_score) - MIN(cognitive_score)) / 4 FROM measurements) FROM measurements)
    OR cognitive_score > (SELECT AVG(cognitive_score) + 3 * (SELECT (MAX(cognitive_score) - MIN(cognitive_score)) / 4 FROM measurements) FROM measurements)
);
